title: August and the Room
author: Xanthe Joubert
blurb: Paloma Quintana, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
